derivation: A repetition among the five cyclic positions of a loopless closed five-walk occurs at cyclic distance two. Removing that immediate backtrack leaves a triangle.
The used-edge graph is either the triangle or the triangle plus one external incident edge, and therefore has a unique triangle; unused chords do not affect uniqueness.
For a walk confined to the triangle, edge multiplicities are all odd and sum to five, hence are 3,1,1. Three choices of tripled edge, two directions and five starts give 30 walks.
An external incident edge yields two directions and five starts. There are 3(8−2)=18 such edges. Thus each triangle contributes 30+18·10=210 non-simple walks, and tr(A⁵)=10C₅+210T.
payload.counterexample_probe: An external endpoint joined to several triangle vertices creates no overcount because those extra edges are not used. Chords likewise do not invalidate the simple-walk contribution.
payload.local_finding: The non-simple count and unique-triangle assignment are justified.
